```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)

library(tidyr)

library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
```

```{r load_metadata}
metadata_file <- "eeg_datatable_082126.xlsx"
raw_meta <- read_excel(metadata_file, na = c("", "NA", "N/A", "n/a", "nan", "NaN"))

animals_df <- raw_meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group) & !str_to_lower(str_trim(Group)) %in% c("", "n/a", "na", "nan")) %>%
  mutate(
    # Clean Animal ID to numeric for consistent matching
    Animal = as.numeric(as.character(Animal)),
    Injury = factor(if_else(str_detect(Group, "TBI"), "TBI", "Sham"), levels = c("Sham", "TBI")),
    CSDs = factor(if_else(str_detect(Group, "\\+CSD"), "CSD", "Saline"), levels = c("Saline", "CSD")),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Sham", "Sham+CSD", "TBI", "TBI+CSD"))
  ) %>%
  select(Animal, Injury, CSDs, Group) %>%
  droplevels()

cat(sprintf("Loaded metadata for %d animals across 4 groups.\n", nrow(animals_df)))
```

```{r load_and_aggregate_spikes}
# Helper to read all CSVs from a hemisphere directory
read_hemisphere_spikes <- function(folder_path, hemisphere_label) {
  if (!dir.exists(folder_path)) {
    warning(sprintf("Directory '%s' not found.", folder_path))
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  csv_files <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  map_dfr(csv_files, function(file) {
    filename <- basename(file)
    animal_id <- as.numeric(substr(filename, 1, 4))
    
    df <- read.csv(file)
    if ("z_amp" %in% names(df)) {
      tibble(
        Animal = animal_id,
        z_amp = abs(as.numeric(df$z_amp)),
        Hemisphere = hemisphere_label
      )
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  })
}

# 1. Load raw spike data from both folders
ipsi_spikes   <- read_hemisphere_spikes("spike_files_ipsi", "Ipsilateral")
contra_spikes <- read_hemisphere_spikes("spike_files_contra", "Contralateral")

# 2. Retain only animals present in BOTH hemispheres
animals_with_ipsi   <- unique(ipsi_spikes$Animal)
animals_with_contra <- unique(contra_spikes$Animal)
bilateral_animals   <- intersect(animals_with_ipsi, animals_with_contra)

cat(sprintf("Animals with Ipsilateral data: %d\n", length(animals_with_ipsi)))
cat(sprintf("Animals with Contralateral data: %d\n", length(animals_with_contra)))
cat(sprintf("Animals with bilateral recordings (both): %d\n", length(bilateral_animals)))

# 3. Collapse multiple spike observations into a SINGLE MEDIAN per animal per hemisphere
animal_medians <- bind_rows(ipsi_spikes, contra_spikes) %>%
  filter(Animal %in% bilateral_animals) %>%
  group_by(Animal, Hemisphere) %>%
  summarise(
    n_spikes = n(),
    z_amp = median(z_amp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 4. Merge with metadata
final_animal_df <- animals_df %>%
  inner_join(animal_medians, by = "Animal") %>%
  filter(!is.na(z_amp)) %>%
  mutate(
    Hemisphere = factor(Hemisphere, levels = c("Contralateral", "Ipsilateral"))
  ) %>%
  droplevels()

cat(sprintf("\nDesign matrix created: %d rows (1 observation per animal per hemisphere across %d unique animals).\n", 
            nrow(final_animal_df), n_distinct(final_animal_df$Animal)))
```

```{r bilateral_lme_function}
# 2-Way Repeated-Measures LME: z_amp (Animal Median) ~ Group * Hemisphere + (1 | Animal)
lme_analysis_bilateral <- function(data, 
                                   groups = c("Sham", "Sham+CSD", "TBI", "TBI+CSD"),
                                   adjust = c("fdr", "none", "tukey", "bonferroni", "holm")) {
  
  adjust <- match.arg(adjust)
  
  # Step A: Filter by selected groups and format variables
  analysis_df <- data %>%
    filter(Group %in% groups) %>%
    mutate(
      Animal = factor(Animal),
      Group = factor(Group, levels = groups),
      Hemisphere = factor(Hemisphere, levels = c("Contralateral", "Ipsilateral")),
      z_amp = as.numeric(z_amp)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(z_amp) & !is.na(Animal)) %>%
    droplevels()
  
  cat("=======================================================\n")
  cat("2-WAY LINEAR MIXED-EFFECTS MODEL (ANIMAL-LEVEL MEDIANS)\n")
  cat("Formula: z_amp ~ Group * Hemisphere + (1 | Animal)\n")
  cat(sprintf("Groups Included: %s\n", paste(levels(analysis_df$Group), collapse = ", ")))
  cat(sprintf("Hemispheres: %s\n", paste(levels(analysis_df$Hemisphere), collapse = ", ")))
  cat(sprintf("Multiple Testing Adjustment: %s\n", toupper(adjust)))
  cat(sprintf("Total Observations: %d | Total Animals: %d\n", nrow(analysis_df), n_distinct(analysis_df$Animal)))
  cat("=======================================================\n\n")
  
  if (n_distinct(analysis_df$Group) < 2) {
    cat("Error: At least 2 groups are required to fit the model.\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Step B: Fit LME with random animal intercepts (pairing the two hemispheres per subject)
  lme_model <- lmer(z_amp ~ Group * Hemisphere + (1 | Animal), data = analysis_df)
  
  # Step C: ANOVA summary (Type III Satterthwaite)
  cat("--- TYPE III ANOVA TABLE (Fixed Effects) ---\n")
  print(anova(lme_model, type = 3))
  cat("\n")
  
  # Step D: Model parameters & coefficients
  cat("--- MODEL COEFFICIENTS & VARIANCE COMPONENTS ---\n")
  print(summary(lme_model))
  cat("\n")
  
  # Step E: Estimated Marginal Means & Pairwise Comparisons
  cat("--- ESTIMATED MARGINAL MEANS: Group * Hemisphere ---\n")
  emm <- emmeans(lme_model, ~ Group * Hemisphere)
  print(summary(emm))
  cat("\n")
  
  cat(sprintf("--- HEMISPHERE CONTRASTS WITHIN EACH GROUP (%s Adjusted) ---\n", toupper(adjust)))
  post_hoc_hemi <- pairs(emm, by = "Group", adjust = adjust)
  print(summary(post_hoc_hemi))
  cat("\n")
  
  cat(sprintf("--- GROUP CONTRASTS WITHIN EACH HEMISPHERE (%s Adjusted) ---\n", toupper(adjust)))
  post_hoc_group <- pairs(emm, by = "Hemisphere", adjust = adjust)
  print(summary(post_hoc_group))
  cat("\n")
  
  return(invisible(list(
    model = lme_model,
    emm = emm,
    post_hoc_hemi = post_hoc_hemi,
    post_hoc_group = post_hoc_group,
    data = analysis_df
  )))
}
```

```{r bilateral_summary_bar_function}
# Prism-style Summary Bar Graph: Mean of Animal Medians + SEM
plot_spike_summary_bar_bilateral <- function(data, 
                                             groups = c("Sham", "Sham+CSD", "TBI", "TBI+CSD"),
                                             title = NULL,
                                             xlab = "",
                                             ylab = "Normalized Amplitude (Animal Median)",
                                             bar_width = 0.7,
                                             aspect_ratio = 1.3) {
  
  # Step A: Filter by passed groups and ensure correct factor levels
  plot_data <- data %>%
    filter(Group %in% groups) %>%
    mutate(
      Group = factor(Group, levels = groups),
      Hemisphere = factor(Hemisphere, levels = c("Contralateral", "Ipsilateral"))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(z_amp)) %>%
    droplevels()
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    warning("No data points found for the specified groups.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Step B: Calculate Mean and SEM across animal medians
  summary_stats <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(Group, Hemisphere) %>%
    summarise(
      n_animals = n(),
      stat_mean = mean(z_amp),
      sem = sd(z_amp) / sqrt(n_animals),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ymin = pmax(0, stat_mean - sem),
      ymax = stat_mean + sem
    )
  
  # Calculate upper y-axis ceiling for clean Prism top number
  max_error_bar <- max(summary_stats$ymax, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_axis_ceiling <- max(pretty(c(0, max_error_bar)))
  
  # Step C: Build the compact Prism-style bar plot
  p <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Group, y = stat_mean, fill = Hemisphere)) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = bar_width, 
      color = "black", 
      linewidth = 1.0, 
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    # Overlay individual animal data points (dodged to match the bars)
    geom_point(
      data = plot_data,
      aes(x = Group, y = z_amp, group = Hemisphere),
      position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8),
      color = "black",
      fill = "white",
      shape = 21,
      size = 2.2,
      stroke = 0.8,
      alpha = 0.85,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = 0.25, 
      linewidth = 1.0, 
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, y_axis_ceiling),
      breaks = function(x) pretty(x, n = 5),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Contralateral" = "#4A90E2", "Ipsilateral" = "#D0021B"),
      name = "Hemisphere"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = xlab,
      y = ylab
    ) +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = aspect_ratio,
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1.0),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1.0),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.18, "cm")
    )
  
  print(p)
  return(invisible(p))
}
```

```{r assumption_diagnostics}
# Assumption Diagnostics Function for Animal-Level LME models
check_lme_normality <- function(lme_result) {
  model <- if (is.list(lme_result) && "model" %in% names(lme_result)) {
    lme_result$model
  } else {
    lme_result
  }
  
  resids <- residuals(model)
  fitted_vals <- fitted(model)
  rand_effs <- unlist(ranef(model)$Animal)
  
  sw_animal <- shapiro.test(rand_effs)
  
  cat("=======================================================\n")
  cat("LINEAR MIXED-EFFECTS MODEL ASSUMPTION DIAGNOSTICS\n")
  cat("=======================================================\n")
  cat(sprintf("Number of Residuals: %d\n", length(resids)))
  cat(sprintf("Number of Random Intercepts (Animals): %d\n", length(rand_effs)))
  cat(sprintf("Shapiro-Wilk Test (Animal Intercepts): W = %.4f, p = %.4f\n", 
              sw_animal$statistic, sw_animal$p.value))
  if (sw_animal$p.value >= 0.05) {
    cat("-> Animal-level random effects meet the normality assumption (p >= 0.05).\n")
  } else {
    cat("-> Animal-level random effects deviate from normality (p < 0.05).\n")
  }
  cat("=======================================================\n\n")
  
  old_par <- par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 3, 1))
  on.exit(par(old_par))
  
  qqnorm(resids, main = "Q-Q: Model Residuals", pch = 20, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.4))
  qqline(resids, col = "#c0392b", lwd = 2)
  
  qqnorm(rand_effs, main = "Q-Q: Animal Random Intercepts", pch = 19, col = "#2b5c8f")
  qqline(rand_effs, col = "#c0392b", lwd = 2)
  
  plot(fitted_vals, resids, main = "Residuals vs. Fitted", xlab = "Fitted Values", ylab = "Residuals",
       pch = 20, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.4))
  abline(h = 0, col = "#c0392b", lty = 2, lwd = 1.5)
  
  hist(resids, breaks = 15, col = "#d9d9d9", border = "black",
       main = "Residual Distribution", xlab = "Residuals", freq = FALSE)
  curve(dnorm(x, mean = mean(resids), sd = sd(resids)), add = TRUE, col = "#c0392b", lwd = 2)
}
```

```{r run_analysis, fig.width=5, fig.height=5.5}
target_groups <- c("Sham", "TBI", "TBI+CSD")

# 1. Run 2-Way LME on Animal-Level Medians
lme_bilateral_results <- lme_analysis_bilateral(
  data = final_animal_df,
  groups = target_groups,
  adjust = "fdr"
)

# 2. Plot Bilateral Bar Plot (Mean of Animal Medians + SEM)
p_bar <- plot_spike_summary_bar_bilateral(
  data = final_animal_df,
  groups = target_groups,
  ylab = "Normalized Amplitude",
  aspect_ratio = 1.3
)

# 3. Model Assumption Diagnostics
check_lme_normality(lme_bilateral_results)
```
